name: David Pimblott
story: David Pimblott's professional background includes more than thirty years of strategic GIS and business consultancy. He studied at Wellington Polytechnic from 1973 to 1978. Alongside the commercial GIS work described in the book, his professional profile records an association with Heart Kids New Zealand and governance training through the Institute of Directors.

David Pimblott worked in New Zealand’s early Esri and ERDAS software market, including distribution, implementation and consulting. He and Beryl Pimblott founded Explorer Graphics in 1987, after his earlier work associated with Eagle Technology.
In his account of the 1983–87 period, Pimblott recalls responsibility for Esri and ERDAS distribution and support before the establishment of Explorer Graphics.
